opportunities.title: Trezor Got Breached Again — The Cold Wallet Was Never the Weak Link, ShipMonk Was

opportunities.angle: Explainer/rant: why hardware wallet security is only as strong as the vendor's weakest third-party integration; checklist for what data was actually exposed and what to do now

opportunities.title: Robinhood Chain 'Never Stopped' — Except When Its Blobs Stopped Reaching Ethereum for 14 Minutes
